retirement_scope: Preserve original metadata initialization and the complete original generic singleton Awake call4707; retire only the subsequent cached Firebase-user read/configuration consumer.
In each original pause/focus method, retire only the actual26068 auth-refresh call, consuming its two already evaluated arguments; retain original time/focus bookkeeping.
Original26068 calls2736, which clears current data-ready state and sends two actual backend reads. Real local profile snapshots must not be reset by an obsolete cloud-resume consumer.
No AuthService UID, account/provider/permission flag or SDK success callback is manufactured. Original providers remain byte-identical.
HTML SDK.init loading-start consumer can be removed independently; Firebase initializeApp and not-yet-audited consumers remain, so this is not a claim of complete SDK retirement.
